generation.mode: one built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with the edit target first and the style canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; delivered water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units were excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-canvas sun gradient is obvious, but repeated pale top facets, darker rock sides, and dark conifer-side/ground shapes still create a directional upper-left light reading. The strict flat-lighting rule is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad coherent pale central bench counts as buildable; only the narrow broken shoreline rim and abrupt shelf margins count as steep; jointed rubble, talus, the tarn margin, scrub, and conifer ground make up the remainder.

shoreLandReachMetres.method: Manual native-resolution shoreline-rim samples across the frame converted by 97.6/1254 metres per source pixel; offshore stacks were not treated as the main shore.

crown.method: Manual full-frame census of every visually identifiable conifer crown, including saplings, edge-clipped crowns, and readable crowns in overlapping groups; widths were measured on the 1254 px source using the 100 px grid and 2x/3x crops, with a 31 source-pixel median scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Flooded blue/teal water from the north, east, and west sea edges; separately flooded the southern shelf tarn; grew connected pale surf and wash; removed warm rock, dark vegetation, and wet components below 64 pixels; then inspected the cyan overlay at native resolution.

refusalReasons: The main shore lies roughly 62-84 m inward from the southern edge, with an estimated 70 m median, instead of the required varying 15-40 m continuation; the candidate therefore leaves only 27.52% open water rather than making the rest of the cell open sea.

The east and west edges are only partly sea (172/1254 and 456/1254 water pixels respectively), contradicting the explicit seaward-edge requirement even though this follows inherited painted overlap visible in the edit target.
Three distinct offshore skerry groups are visible, exceeding the requested one or two.
Rock facets and conifer-side/ground values retain a directional lighting read, so the strict same-value-on-every-side rule fails visual inspection despite the low aggregate first-moment metric.
openRisks: The water mask was traced and overlay-inspected at source resolution, but no pipeline cut/bake was run because the task is quarantine-only.
The crown census includes every identified sapling and clipped/overlapping crown with no exclusions, but boundaries inside dense overlap remain an approximate manual measurement.

The preserved eastern and western neighbor paint conflicts with the written requirement that those entire cell edges be sea; resolving that authority conflict would require a new source/context decision, not post-processing this one-call output.
